definitions.Ignored Spec File: A file under an active Spec folder that Git ignores, so no commit holds it. The Archive Command and the Cancel Command refuse while one exists (ADR-0269).
definitions.Folder Removal Recovery: How the Archive Command and the Cancel Command end when the final removal of the Spec folder fails: every write stays in place, and the command prints the command that finishes the removal (ADR-0269).
